canonical_project: Poseidon Sabah / Aeropod Tier IV-quality data centre
owner: Poseidon Technologies Sdn Bhd with Permodalan RISDA Berhad
notes: 2023 reports described an RM119 million Tier IV-quality facility at Aeropod near Kota Kinabalu, expected then by July 2024. Baxtel later lists the project as planned for 2028. A July 9, 2025 Daily Express report quotes Sabah's Industrial Development and Entrepreneurship Minister saying Sabah is not ready for data centre investments due to water and electricity limits, so status remains planned rather than construction/operational.
